title: Serial monitor and diagnostics

spans.text: LESSON PURPOSE

Goal: apply “Serial monitor and diagnostics” to a real program or device. The key principle is: Serial.available reports whether input is available. In a project, follow this guidance: Both ends must agree on baud rate and line endings.
QUESTION: What will this example do? Predict the result first.
EXAMPLE CODE
EXPECTED RESULT
Each received serial byte is printed as its numeric value; input and line endings affect the result.
CORE EXPLANATION
Serial.begin sets the baud rate; the monitor can display logs and simple commands. Define a line format, validate received input, and keep secrets out of serial output.
IMPORTANT LINE BREAKDOWN
Key line:
if (Serial.available()) {

What it does: Serial.available reports whether input is available.
Why it is used: Both ends must agree on baud rate and line endings.
If omitted or changed: Both ends must agree on baud rate and line endings.
